thesis: Teledyne Technologies (NYSE: TDY): instrumentation, digital imaging, aerospace and defense electronics, engineered systems. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-23) read. Q3 sales 1,684.9M (+9.4%, acquisitions 11.7M), 9M 4,907.5M (+9.0%); Q3 NI 272.8M (+23.6%), 9M NI 751.3M (+21.3%) helped by lower cost of sales percentage (56.1% vs 57.2%) and tariff refunds recorded mainly in Q2 (amount not read). 9M OCF 901.7M (vs 812.3M), capex 93.2M, inventories +193.7M; repaid 450M notes in April, debt 2,027.8M vs cash 562.4M, buybacks 94.8M in 9M with 1.5B authorization left. Close 598.56 (2026-11-20, -3.7% that day, cause not found) x 46.04M shares = 27.56B = 26.8x TTM NI 1,026.9M; TTM FCF 1,147.7M (4.2%); 2.5x book.
counterthesis: A high quality compounder priced for it: 26.8x TTM earnings and 4.2% FCF yield with 9% growth; part of margin gain is tariff refund and mix; inventories rose 18% in nine months; goodwill and intangibles are 68% of assets so acquisitions drive risk; defense and Middle East exposure not quantified; the -3.7% fall on 11-20 is unexplained.
invalidation: Downgrade if organic growth stalls below mid single digits, margins give back the refund and mix gain, or acquisition pricing rises sharply; a valuation case needs a price near or under about 22x normalized earnings (own judgment, not a forecast).
